# Devbhoomi Infotech Solutions

> Technology and digital growth partner based in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India.

## About the Organization
Devbhoomi Infotech Solutions is an IT and digital growth agency specializing in custom full-stack web development, bespoke software systems, AI-powered business automations, and search engine visibility. Rooted in Uttarakhand, the agency serves enterprises, startups, and institutions across India.

- **Headquarters**: Near Dhalwala, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India (249201)
- **Primary Website**: https://www.devbhoomiinfotech.com
- **Phone**: +91 81260 06791
- **Email**: infotechdevbhoomi@gmail.com
- **Business Hours**: Monday - Saturday, 09:30 AM - 06:30 PM IST

## Core Practice Areas
1. **AI & Business Automation**: Custom AI agents, conversational chatbots, automated CRM/lead pipelines, and n8n/API workflow automations.
2. **Custom Software & SaaS Development**: Scalable web applications, cloud dashboards, Next.js/React full-stack engineering, and internal management tools.
3. **Website Design & Web Development**: High-performance, responsive corporate websites, educational portals, hospitality platforms, and e-commerce architectures.
4. **Digital Growth, SEO & GEO**: Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), technical and on-page SEO, local SEO in Uttarakhand, and conversion rate optimisation.
